$comment: Written by hand from docs/evidence/adopt/adopt-proposal.json on 23 October 2026 because /bob adopt refuses a repo that already holds bob/ledger.json (R-bob-05). States and transitions: bob/schema.json. No state here comes from prose.

requirements.text: the BOB repo is BOB-governed: bob/brief.json exists, main unchanged until approved
requirements.check: Gate A refuses an unapproved write in a session on this repo

requirements.text: every BOB round ends with a report of at most three lines (stage, live, next step with its doer) before any detail
requirements.check: a round whose closing report breaks the shape is blocked at Stop with the shape named

requirements.text: each decision for Ash is asked once, as one popup, in the window that will run the answer, and the ask names that window
requirements.check: the next adoption costs Ash exactly two typed commands and no retry

requirements.text: a /bob command typed in a session where the plugin is not loaded is answered with the window to use
requirements.check: typing /bob status in a session on a non-BOB folder returns one line naming the workspace session

requirements.text: a session on a governed repo opens with the board visible: pane drawn, docs/status.html written and its path in the first message, before any question
requirements.check: the first assistant message of a session on ~/BOB or VGA names docs/status.html

requirements.text: /bob adopt accepts a repo that already holds bob/ledger.json, merging increments and never overwriting a record
requirements.check: adopt on this repo writes bob/brief.json and appends increments with every existing ledger record byte-identical

requirements.text: after /bob approve, the pane and the page show the approver and the time within the same turn
requirements.check: the page's APPROVAL field names the AP record

requirements.text: the design room's first run in Cowork is recorded with what Ash saw and disliked, as sources for the next increment
requirements.check: a sources/ file from that run exists

decisions.text: BOB's own build runs under BOB from 23 October 2026; every later change is an approved increment

assumptions.text: a Stop hook can read the closing report (U-02)
a user-level instruction line can answer a /bob command where the plugin is not loaded (U-01)

outputs.text: a three-line closing report every round
